@threads.definition: Threads are manifest-declared execution lanes for XCFE/KUHUL work units. They schedule runnable nodes but do not bypass phase admission.
@threads.authority: JSON declares thread topology; XCFE/KUHUL executes admitted steps.

fold_mapping.pop: read thread declarations and input bindings
fold_mapping.wo: bind thread ids, targets, and dependency edges
fold_mapping.yax: rank legal runnable threads and join policy
fold_mapping.xul: record replay/provenance and close joined threads

rules: Thread ids must be unique within a manifest.
Threads may share inputs by reference only when store_shared is true.
Thread execution order is deterministic for equal priority lanes.
A thread cannot invoke filesystem, network, process, GPU, or model routes unless the mounted policy admits that capability.

@routes.name: thread_manifest_describe
@routes.returns: thread manifest capability and scheduling law
